measurement.CPU: /proc/PID/stat utime+stime; process percent has one CPU at 100%, may exceed 100%
measurement.RSS: Linux process resident memory; includes heap, native allocations, code and mappings
measurement.heap: jstat -gc observed region capacities/usages; excludes metaspace/CCS; samples, not allocation rate
measurement.GC: jstat cumulative GC count/time deltas; times are elapsed seconds, not tick time or pause distribution
measurement.jstat_raw: Both -gc and -gcutil raw stdout preserved with independent read intervals
measurement.MSPT: Not measured. No full-server JFR, tick instrumentation or stop-the-world pause claim.
measurement.sidecar: Read-only observer creates short jstat processes; match its sampling before/after.
